capabilities: Capture and annotate screenshots with structured issue context
Reload plugins live and auto-reload on build output changes
Browse and copy icon IDs available to setIcon and addRibbonIcon
Inspect CSS custom properties with live computed values
List registered commands with owning plugins and effective hotkeys
disambiguation: Not a code editor or general IDE; it is a set of tools for building and debugging Obsidian plugins and reporting issues about them.
extras: Desktop only; screenshot capture and plugin reloading rely on desktop APIs unavailable on Obsidian mobile. The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian provides no built-in tooling for plugin developers to debug builds, inspect internal registries, or file issues with structured environment context.

relations.evidence: BRAT lets power users install pre-release builds before they reach the marketplace.

summary: Developer tools suite that captures annotated screenshots with issue context, live-reloads plugins during development, and inspects icons, CSS variables, and commands.
